items.title: Pete Barbutti interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 8, 2022
items.q: So I took them out and I met Art Rush there and he gave me a nice hug

ctx.x: Yeah. I have to tell you, in fact one of the great stories of my life, I’m working a club in Seattle. This was right after Spokane. It was the year of the World’s Fair in 1962. I have a

great trio behind me and I’m working this little club called Rosellini’s 410. It was a very hip place, and it was packed every night. I’m working it and somebody sends up a note that says, “Rafael Mendez is in the audience.” And I said well it’s somebody named Rafael Mendez but obviously it’s not THE Rafael Mendez, he’s the greatest classical trumpet player that ever lived. And from the back of the room I hear, “Yeah he’s here.” I said, “What’s he doing here?” “He’s conducting the orchestra out at the fairgrounds…
